name: Command
intent: A search field over a grouped list of pages, records and actions. Typing filters the list; arrow keys and Enter pick.
usage: Use Command for quick jumps and actions across the app, like a global search. It is one component: pass groups of items as data. Typing filters by label and description. Arrow keys move the highlight and Enter picks; Escape clears the search. It shows inline; a ⌘K palette comes later. See contracts/command.json for the full contract.

itemShape.heading: string?
itemShape.items: CommandItem[]: { id: string, label: string, description?: string, icon?: string, shortcut?: string, disabled?: boolean }

groups.note: Groups are split by a thin line. icon is a Material Symbols name. shortcut shows as a key, like N.

label.note: Name of the search field and the list for screen readers.

placeholder.default: Search by name, type, and more...

empty.default: No matches found for this search.

defaultQuery.note: Start with a search already typed.

hints.note: Footer with the arrow keys to browse and Enter to select.

onSelect.note: (id: string) => void. Runs on Enter or click.

useWhen: A global search across pages, records and reports.
A quick list of actions people find by typing.
doNot: Do not invent CommandInput, CommandList, CommandItem, CommandGroup, CommandEmpty, CommandDialog or SearchPanel.
Do not use for a short list of actions from a button. Use DropdownMenu.
Do not use for choosing a form value. Use RadioGroup, or Select when it exists.
Do not wrap it in a local overlay or build a ⌘K palette yet.
a11y: The search field is a combobox with aria-controls, aria-autocomplete=list and aria-activedescendant pointing at the highlighted option.
The list is a listbox; groups are labelled by their heading; items are options with aria-selected and aria-disabled.
Focus stays in the search field. Arrow keys move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape clears the search.
A polite status message says how many results match.
The key hints footer is hidden from screen readers; icons are decorative.
